objective: Validate every registered book and SOTA algorithm on as many task-compatible local datasets as possible, while keeping engineering transfer results separate from exact paper-score reproduction.

rules: Split by complete process run, device, equipment, or simulator seed; never split adjacent windows from one source group across partitions.
Fit normalization, thresholds, dictionaries, templates, calibration scores, and hyperparameters on train/calibration only.
Use the same dataset adapter, split manifest, metric version, and seed list for all methods in one comparison lane.
Synthetic smoke, descriptive candidates, M1 mismatch sentinels, and transfer studies cannot be promoted as paper-score reproductions.
A frozen held-out test partition is evaluated once per protocol version.
Negative, null, degenerate, and failed-activation results remain in the evidence ledger.

allowed: model hyperparameters declared before the held-out run
forbidden_after_freeze: unregistered post-hoc seed or dataset selection

matching_grades.M3: Native representation and task labels/ground truth are present; suitable for primary benchmark evidence.
matching_grades.M2: Representation is task-compatible but labels or domain are transferred/derived; suitable for engineering multi-dataset evidence.
matching_grades.M1: Representation or labels are materially mismatched; diagnostic sentinel only.
matching_grades.M0: Invalid or unusable pairing; do not execute.

protocol_fidelity.P3: Same paper dataset, split, preprocessing, hyperparameters, metrics, and reference item.
protocol_fidelity.P2: Same dataset family and reconstructed paper protocol, with documented differences.
protocol_fidelity.P1: Cross-dataset transfer protocol; no paper-score claim.
protocol_fidelity.P0: Activation, smoke, descriptive, or mismatch-only evidence.

evidence_tiers.E1: Activation beacon passes on a bounded smoke or diagnostic slice.
evidence_tiers.E2: One real/acquired dataset engineering validation with frozen split.
evidence_tiers.E3: At least three M2/M3 datasets, three fixed seeds, aggregate and per-dataset results.
evidence_tiers.E4: A named book/paper experiment item reproduced under P2 or P3 with a declared tolerance.
evidence_tiers.E5: Once-only held-out evaluation after all earlier gates are locked.

seed_policy.rule: Every stochastic formal comparison reports per-seed results, mean, standard deviation, and a paired confidence interval.

gates.pass: Payload integrity, schema/profile, group split, leakage audit, label semantics, and metric denominator all pass.
gates.failure_action: Block scoring; retain the audit record.

gates.pass: Algorithm-specific beacon is non-degenerate: predictions vary when expected, training loss/fit changes when applicable, and outputs are finite.
gates.failure_action: Diagnose representation, label, scaling, window, or implementation mismatch before tuning.

gates.pass: At least three M2/M3 datasets and three formal seeds finish, or a documented domain-specific exception is approved before execution.
gates.failure_action: Keep E1/E2 evidence but do not claim multi-dataset validation.

gates.pass: For claims of improvement over the frozen lane parent, paired mean delta is positive and the two-sided normal approximation satisfies |z| >= 1.96; multiplicity is disclosed.
gates.failure_action: Retain the valid negative/null result and deny superiority language.

gates.pass: Named table/figure/case item, source hash, exact differences, target tolerance, and observed delta are recorded under P2/P3.
gates.failure_action: Label as independent reimplementation or transfer validation.

gates.pass: Protocol hash is frozen and the held-out partition is scored once with no subsequent selection.
gates.failure_action: A changed hypothesis requires a new protocol version and a new untouched holdout.

comparison_lanes.activation_beacon: finite parameters, both alarm states reachable, and response changes under threshold/delay perturbation
non-empty learned zone and non-constant signed violation or alarm output
at least one finite non-zero edge/contribution or posterior movement from the prior
at least two predicted classes or a justified open-set rejection, plus non-constant prefix scores
non-uniform predictive distribution and evaluable vocabulary coverage
every rendered aggregate round-trips to frozen facts and source episode IDs

stages.title: Data priors, adapters, split manifests, and protocol freeze
stages.exit_gate: G0_validity passes for every admitted dataset family; all matrix and reference targets validate.

stages.title: Runner integration and activation
stages.exit_gate: All 30 algorithms have a runner path, bounded config, unit tests, and G1 activation evidence.

stages.title: Fair train/calibration tuning on at least two datasets
stages.exit_gate: No test access; per-lane parents and search budgets are frozen.

stages.title: Three-seed multi-dataset validation and book/paper experiment rows
stages.exit_gate: G2 passes; each reference row is P1/P2/P3-labelled and G4 is evaluated.

stages.title: Component ablations, missing/spurious/jitter/delay, prefix, and open-set tests
stages.exit_gate: Same datasets/seeds as S3; paired deltas and failure modes are retained.

stages.title: Once-only held-out scoring, independent audit, figures, and claim ledger
stages.exit_gate: G5 passes and no P0/P1 result is phrased as an exact reproduction.

cpu_medium.use: transfer entropy, pattern mining, and full classical sweeps

negative_result_policy.known_sentinel: PRONTO T4 state-window results for CTFH, HDAM, ConE, Cross-Conformal, and CASIM remain visible as M1/P0 representation-label mismatch evidence.
